title: Wildfire strengthens the relationship between soil biodiversity and ecosystem multifunctionality in subtropical forests
content:
Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.


Abstract

Wildfires are disrupting and regenerating forces in nature that affect all ecosystem components. However, the impact of wildfires on soil multitrophic biodiversity and the resulting consequences for ecosystem multifunctionality (EMF) remain poorly understood. In this study, we sampled fire chronosequences (1, 5, 9 and 27 year) from burned and unburned plots in subtropical Pinus yunnanensis forests to determine the soil biodiversity (bacteria, fungi, protists and nematodes), together with an extensive array of 38 ecosystem functions related to microbial activity, organic matter decomposition and mineralization, and nutrient cycling. The responses of soil biodiversity and EMF varied with soil depth and time since fire. In the surface layer (0–10 cm), a general pattern emerged in all taxonomic groups, with initial declines in soil biodiversity compared with the unburned plots, but the greatest losses only at 5 years post-fire and reversing to positive in the long term. The EMF broadly followed this pattern, but the loss of EMF occurred earlier and lasted longer, indicating a lower resistance of EMF than biodiversity. Biodiversity responses in the subsurface layer were generally weaker after an initial strong transient enhancement at 1 year. Notably, we found that regardless of the taxonomic group, fire systematically strengthened the relationship between soil biodiversity and EMF, thus promoting post-fire regeneration of EMF. This study sheds new light on the importance of biodiversity in the functioning of ecosystems in an era in which wildfire regimes are altered by global climate change.

摘要

野火是生态系统中的重要干扰，既具有破坏性，也具有更新作用，影响着生态系统的各个组成部分。然而，野火对土壤多个类群生物多样性的影响及其对生态系统多功能性产生的后果，仍然知之甚少。 本研究在亚热带云南松林区选取了不同火烧年限 (1年、5年、9年和27年) 样地，并在每个年限的火烧样地附近选择未火烧地块作为对照，评估了土壤细菌、真菌、原生生物和线虫的生物多样性，同时测定了38项与微生物活性、有机质分解与矿化、养分循环等相关的生态功能指标。 研究结果表明，土壤生物多样性与生态系统多功能性对野火的响应取决于土壤深度与火后恢复时间。在表层土壤 (0-10 cm) 中，相较于未火烧样地，所有类群的生物多样性在火烧初期均下降，最大下降出现在火烧后第5年，随着时间演替土壤生物多样性逐渐恢复，在火后27年甚至超过对照水平。生态系统多功能性变化趋势大致与生物多样性一致，但其下降发生更早且持续时间更长，表明生态系统多功能性的抗干扰能力低于其所依赖的生物多样性。相比之下，亚表层土壤 (10-20 cm) 中的生物多样性对野火的响应较弱，但在火后1年短暂增加。值得注意的是，本研究发现火烧增强了所有类群的土壤生物多样性与生态系统多功能性之间的关系，表明野火有助于生物多样性对生态系统多功能性的促进作用。 在全球气候变化导致野火频率和强度不断增加的背景下，本研究为生物多样性对生态系统功能维持的重要性提供了新的科学证据。
